title: Why IAM-A reads low on plasma
set_out: Test the two causes synthetic test cfDNA 1 found for plasma's low IAM-A, the mix of cells and short molecules, each on the 30 tuning plasmas through the one command.
open_at_turnover: Plasma: IAM-A's cause open (neither the mix nor molecule length); the domains follow the erythrocyte progenitor share.

sections.heading: What ran, and how each came out

entries.title: IAM-A on plasma on the molecule-level loose share
entries.what: The 30 tuning plasmas read on a line built on the share of loose molecules, which mixing cells does not change.
entries.outcome: 0.7618, against 0.7733 on the tile line: the mix of cells is not why plasma reads low.

entries.title: Synthetic test cfDNA 3: the held error's length bias removed
entries.what: Constructed molecules cut to 6, 8, 12 and 20 calls, through the one command.
entries.outcome: Met: the corrected held error within 1 % of the truth at every length.

entries.title: IAM-A on plasma on the length-corrected line
entries.what: Healthy pass 8 (140 inputs) and the 30 plasmas counted again with the corrected held error, read on a line rebuilt on it.
entries.outcome: Plasma 0.7485, healthy 0.9420: molecule length is not the cause either; the cause is open.
